items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: So I gigged around with George Hornsby for quite awhile

ctx.x: George Hornsby. So he had an orchestra and he said -- he came in the club one night and he said, "Hey, kid, can you read?" I said, "Well, I can make out," you know. So he said, "Well, let me hear something fast." So Gene, who

would always take care of me, you know, he would play something, so he said, "That's pretty good. Here's my address and everything and here's where we rehearse. Now, do you think you could be there tomorrow about 2:00 o'clock?" So I said, "Well, I'll try, you know." So he said, "Well, don't worry about an instrument, because our trumpet player, he's an instrument repair man, so we have all the instruments that we need." So I said okay, and the next day I went, and they had a lot of stock arrangements which were…
